original_failures: Initial SDK compilation found a duplicate quaternion type; the existing type was reused.
An initial math-test compilation used an ambiguous target-typed constructor; the test now names Vector3d explicitly.
Initial Linux linking lacked required linker-wrapper environment; source objects were retained and relinked.
The publisher fixture exceeded its original 90-second limit on the mounted drive; the unchanged test and limit passed on an owned native Linux filesystem.
A descriptor invocation combined mutually exclusive runtime and self-test modes; each was invoked separately.
Initial sample authoring used unsupported uppercase color spelling, then omitted required save-load UI/control/material guards. Successors use supported authored values and exact guards.
A comparison authored integer pose zeros against returned float64 fields; new requests use explicit floating-point literals and retain strict response-type checks.

Complete cold-continuation comparison exposed one differing UI text field and its derived snapshot SHA caused by old process save-ticket history. The sample now checks the current restore epoch; all 59 saved fields and the complete comparison remain.

The first Windows build used a different spelling of the existing CMake source path and triggered unnecessary dependency work; it was explicitly interrupted, retained failed, and completed using the existing canonical path.

The first GPU fixture completed its six renders and pixel checks but failed final process metadata publication by using an unsupported transport property. Its failed verdict remains; a successor uses process_id.
scope: Adapted licensed scene and authored compiled consumer; not fresh-agent game creation or an Alpha gate.
